body.statement: For arbitrary sequences \((d_n,K_n)\) as \(n\to\infty\), \(R(n,d_n,K_n)=O(n^{-1})\) if and only if both \(d_n\) and \(K_n\) are bounded.
body.justification: This gives a complete and dimension-uniform answer for when parametric MSE is possible even before the intermediate consistency frontier is closed.
body.gap: LuedtkeVanderLaan2016 studies fixed-complexity regularity. The static theorem in WhitehouseAusternSyrgkanis2025 assumes a \(\delta\)-polynomial density for each suboptimality gap, \(\beta_n=\omega(n^{1/[2(1+\delta)]})\), specified \(L^2\) nuisance rates, uniform boundedness, and positive limiting variance; neither paper gives the necessary-and-sufficient unrestricted \((d_n,K_n)\) minimax criterion.
body.consumer: Practitioners can distinguish benign fixed-menu asymptotics from regimes where expanding personalization complexity necessarily destroys parametric accuracy.
